messages:
emma: Quick ping — the nightly link-scan flagged a broken anchor in docs/runtime/serving.md (#request-routing). Can someone take a tiny ownership + anchor fix? /cc @rafael infra-bot: [alert] link-scan: broken fragment /docs/runtime/serving.md#request-routing detected 2025-06-11T02:14:02Z (rule: fragment-exists) rafael: I can pick this up. Do we prefer to re-add the old slug or add an explicit id to the header? emma: Old PR 7642 changed the header wording so the slug shifted. Two options: 1) re-add an explicit HTML id on the Request routing header, e.g. `

Request routing

` or 2) add a frontmatter redirect for the fragment. I'd prefer the explicit id. Also we should add an OWNERS entry so we know who to ping next time. rafael: Sounds good. Plan: a) add explicit id to header b) update OWNERS.yaml to include rafael for runtime/serving.md c) add changelog line in docs/CHANGELOG.md. I'll run the local link checker and mkdocs build before opening the PR. ETA ~40m. zhen: Quick note: adding the explicit id keeps search/perf stable (our indexer respects anchors). If you add the OWNERS entry, make sure it's under the correct path format: `runtime/serving.md: - rafael` emma: thanks — can you also put a one-line note in the PR description: "fixes link-scan #432 (broken fragment)" so the automation auto-closes the ticket? \infra-bot: (reminder) run `tools/link-checker --site-dir site` in CI to validate fragments. rafael: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8523 — title "docs: serving doc anchor + owner". Included commit message and CHANGELOG entry: "2025-06-11 — runtime/serving: restore fragment id + add owner — rafael" zhen: Reviewing. One nit: OWNERS.yaml expects lowercase paths without leading slash; also add your GitHub handle next to the name if you want notifications. rafael: Updated PR to lowercase path and added handle. Ran `mkdocs build` and `tools/link-checker` locally — no broken fragments. Pushed force-update. infra-bot: Deploy preview ready — https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.com/8523 — link-checker: passed, page returns 200. zhen: LGTM aside from a tiny YAML spacing nit I pushed as a follow-up commit on your branch. rafael: Thanks, fixed. Ready to merge after CI green. emma: Awesome. After merge can we add a quick card to the sprint board to rotate doc owners every quarter? I can create that. rafael: Sounds good. Merging post-green. :white_check_mark:
